newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: German tourist victim of shark attack - Australia police.
newsitem.headline: German tourist victim of shark attack - Australia police.

text.p: A 41-year-old German male tourist holidaying in Western Australia appears to have been attacked and killed by a shark, police said on Tuesday.
A police spokesman in Perth said the tourist went windsurfing on Monday afternoon in the Indian Ocean off the costal community town of Geralton about 470 km (294 miles) north of Perth.
He was reported missing a short time later but a sea and air search on Monday evening failed to locate him.
"The search was resumed at 5.00 a.m. this morning (2100 GMT Monday) and focused on an area about 10 nautical miles off shore," the spokesman said.
"At about 10.45 a.m. (0245 GMT) they found a wet suit and harness floating in the water. The wetsuit was torn about and with jagged tears," he said.
"No body has been found. It appears the tourist was a victim of a shark attack. The search is being scaled down and is now a shore search."
The spokesman said the tourist's name would not be released until the police his family in Germany.
